text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without letting her fatigue show on her 
face, K.S.Miracle bravely prepared for the 
race. Step by step, she was walking toward 
the dark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, bearing the responsibility of 
having given her that first push, her 
Trainer could only send her off to the 
Centaur Stakes.
